module: Class of a race path segment: stretch between two pathnodes (from and to). Three representations are planned: "waypoint" (straight line between the two nodes), a navgraph path automatically filled with capsules, or manual capsules (points with radius). The segment tells whether a vehicle is inside it (contains) and whether it reached the end node (finished). The module returns a factory: require('/lua/ge/extensions/gameplay/race/segment')(path, name, forceId).
notes: Inconsistent mode names: the local modes list is {'waypoint', 'navgraphCapsule', 'manualCapsules'}, but the code tests 'waypoint', 'navpath' and 'capsules'. The values 'navgraphCapsule' and 'manualCapsules' are handled nowhere: contains then returns false.
A capsule is a point {pos, radius, name}; a segment's capsules link from, the capsulePoints, then to. The radius is linearly interpolated along each stretch.
The capsules generated by fillNavpath carry _generated = true and are recomputed on each call of fillNavpath.
isValid reads .missing on the from and to pathnodes: Lua error if either id does not exist in path.pathnodes.objects.
contains in waypoint mode requires state.currentSegments, state.previousCorners and state.currentCorners.

C.desc: Race segment. Fields: path, id, name ("Segment <id>" by default), mode ('waypoint' by default), from and to (pathnode ids, -1 if none), capsulePoints, sortOrder, _drawMode.

init.desc: Constructor: id, name, mode 'waypoint', from/to at -1, empty capsule list.

getBeNavpath.desc: Indicates whether both end pathnodes are in navgraph mode (hence whether a navgraph path is possible).

setFrom.desc: Sets the start pathnode (by id) and revalidates the mode.

setTo.desc: Sets the end pathnode (by id) and revalidates the mode.

checkMode.desc: Revalidates the mode after an end change: in 'navpath' mode, recomputes the path if possible, otherwise returns to 'waypoint'.

setMode.desc: Changes the mode: 'waypoint' clears the capsules; 'navpath' fills them from the navgraph.

fillNavpath.desc: Fills the capsules with the intermediate nodes of the shortest path map.getPath between the navgraph nodes from and to (ends excluded).

addCapsule.desc: Inserts a capsule at the given index (at the end by default).

removeCapsule.desc: Removes the capsule at the given index.

getCapsuleCount.desc: Number of capsule points, ends included (#capsulePoints + 2).

getCapsuleNode.desc: Point i of the capsule chain: 1 = pathnode from, last = pathnode to, otherwise a capsulePoint.

capsuleContains.desc: Indicates whether a point is inside the capsule stretch between points id and id+1 (distance to the segment less than the interpolated radius).

id.desc: Index of the first point of the stretch.

contains.desc: Indicates whether the vehicle is inside the segment. In waypoint mode: true if it is already in this segment (state.currentSegments) or has just crossed the start pathnode. In 'capsules' or 'navpath' mode: true if it is inside one of the capsules.

finished.desc: Indicates whether the vehicle has just crossed the end pathnode (intersectCorners).

onSerialize.desc: Serializes the segment (name, mode, from, to, oldId, capsules).

onDeserialized.desc: Restores the segment; converts from/to with oldIdMap, applies the mode then adds the saved capsules.

drawDebug.desc: Draws the segment (prism between the two nodes in waypoint mode, capsules and edges otherwise) and its name. Draws nothing if the segment is invalid.

isValid.desc: Indicates whether the from and to pathnodes exist, are not marked missing and are different.
